name: Anadolu Fantasy Manager
description: Anadolu Fantasy Manager is a local-first fantasy football manager for Turkish football. It uses a public GitHub JSON feed for the 2026/27 Turkish league snapshot, roster pool, news, and future fixtures/results, then keeps fantasy state on the phone with Room/DataStore. The app includes a News tab with source-linked league, transfer, data, and result items, hash-checks feed files before import, and works offline from the latest bundled or synced snapshot. It remains independent, text-only, and has no private backend, accounts, cloud league, official marks, embedded shared API key, betting, prizes, or gambling mechanics.
releaseNotes: v0.1.1 public feed update: replaces the fictional demo field with the current 18-club 2026/27 Turkish league field and a 522-player roster snapshot; adds a hash-checked public GitHub data feed at yustein/AnadoluFantasyData, launch/manual Sync imports, Room feed/news tables, a News tab with source links, and preseason fixture/result placeholders. The no-central-server shape is preserved: GitHub is only the public JSON distribution repo, while squads, lineup, scoring, sharing, and friend-score state stay local. No official logos/photos/kit art, copied articles, betting, prizes, or shared provider keys are included.
